In 2019 prediabetes was diagnosed, and insulin therapy was initiated despite the prediabetes label, raising concern for unrecorded progression to type 2 diabetes. Blood pressure at the last visit was low (107/68 mmHg) and A1c was recorded as 3.1%, which is likely erroneous. Psychosocial stressors, social isolation, and unsatisfactory housing have been noted since 2020, potentially affecting adherence and overall risk. No recent lipid panel, BMI, or renal labs are available.
